In Re : Mojibar
Rahaman @ Majibur & Ors on 15 April, 2024
 15.04.2024
 51
 S.D./A.D.
 Rejected
 C.R.M. (A) No. 1286 of 2024

In Re:- An application for anticipatory bail under S
 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure in connection with I
 Police Station Case No. 498 of 2023 dated 12.07.2023 under
Sections 498A/304B of the Indian Penal Code.

And
 In Re : Mojibar Rahaman @ Majibur & Ors. ..... 
 Mr. Sourav Mondal
 Mr. M. Nazar Chowdhury
 Mr. Rony Mondal
 .....for the petitioners
 Ms. Sonali Das
 Mr. Soumen Chatterjee
 ....for the State
 1.
We have considered the materials on record.
Victim-wife was tortured and committed suicide within three months of marriage.
Statements of witnesses implicate the petitioners in her torture for demand of dowry.
2. Under such circumstances, we are of the opinion that this is not a fit case to grant anticipatory bail to the petitioners.
3. The application for anticipatory bail is, thus, rejected.
